text_block_list.name: Transcend's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Are you... Tran!?
Yo, good to see you since our last meetup!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through Yukoma Onsen,
a woman in her early twenties called out to us.
She seemed to recognize Transcend.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~~, what a coincidence!
Whatcha doing here?

text_block_list.name: Transcend's Friend
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad you asked...!
Hey Tran, mind hearing me out for a second!?

text_block_list.name: Transcend's Friend
text_block_list.text:
—So, I'm doing a PR gig here right now.
I was planning to build a sauna by hand and upload a vlog of the process, but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend's Friend
text_block_list.text:
I can't think of what would be good at all, man...
Tran, what do you think I should do?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Local PR for Yukoma Onsen, huh...
...Hey, Trainy. Don't you get the feeling
this might not be entirely unrelated to us?
choice_data_list: Yeah, we can't just leave it alone!
Yeah, we can't just leave it alone!

text_block_list.name: Transcend's Friend
text_block_list.text: Huh... Seriously? Are you sure?!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me, leave it to me.
First, let's nail down the concept.
Trainy, what kind of vibe do you think is good?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"In situations like this, it's probably important to consider
the user's perspective. In that case—"
choice_data_list: Maybe we should get ideas from everyone.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I like that. Let's do that!
Alright then, off we go on our inquiry investigation~

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What kind of sauna is best?
There can only be one answer!
—A sauna that makes the beautiful me shine even more radiantly!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Mmm... I see.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Um, how about
your friend who came along with you?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...We didn't come together. We just ran into each other.
I prefer... a quiet sauna."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Hmm, let's see...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...That answer might've been a bit too eccentric.
What're we gonna do, Trai-chan? Got any ideas?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I try recalling the clues gathered from asking around...
"Where a beautiful me can shine even brighter"—
"A quiet place"—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I pondered, a certain place came to mind.
I decided to take Transcend there.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! What a nice, cool place this is.
It's pretty, and so quiet—
choice_data_list: Right, I thought somewhere pretty and quiet would be nice.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This is—a river fairly close to the hot spring town.
It's a spot where swimming is permitted as well.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
! I see. So that's how you took what just happened.
Not bad at all, Trainy~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Yeah, looks nice. We could even play in the river instead of using a cold bath!
choice_data_list: Right? I'm sure it'll feel amazing once you get in—
Right? I'm sure it'd feel amazing once you get in—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Sliiiip*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—My footing slipped.
By the time I realized something was wrong, it was already too late.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SPLAAAAAAASH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Whoa!? Trainey, are you okay...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, it looks like she isn't injured.
And what's more—
choice_data_list: (Huh, it's cold but it feels kinda nice...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It feels just like stepping into a cold bath after a sauna.
The river water is so soothing on a body overheated by late summer..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...Yes?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I see. It really is nice and cool.
It's perfect to use instead of a cold plunge~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
――Ah. Hey, a fish just swam by.
Right below your knees, Trai-chan――
choice_data_list: You're right! Wait, now it's heading toward Tran—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Wait... No way!?
—Whoa, it's true!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha, ahahahaha!
Wait, wait, that tickles!
choice_data_list: Could this be... a brand-new thrill discovered...!?
Could this be... a brand-new thrill discovered, I wonder...!?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Thrill, or rather, it's just tickling—
—Ahaha! Wait, I can't take it anymore!
Stop it, really... Ahahaha!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We agreed on using the river as a cold plunge,
and soaked our feet in the water for a while to cool off.

text_block_list.name: Transcend's Friend
text_block_list.text:
A riverside sauna?
Playing in the river as a cold plunge!? Whoa,
that gets me so freakin' pumped!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, having secured the necessary permissions,
we decided to build a sauna by the river.
—Let's make it an amazing sauna, for promotion's sake too!
